title: Email
intro: Your unread emails, sorted into a dashboard: people, work, notifications, promos and junk. Rate the AI’s answers and it learns your preferences.

setup.title: Connect your mailbox
setup.subtitle: It takes a few seconds, once. Your login stays on this computer.
setup.helpApp: {provider} asks for an “app password”: a special password you create in your account’s security settings, to use instead of your usual password.
setup.helpOther: Enter your address and password. If needed, fill in the server in the advanced settings.
setup.needHost: Enter the server in the advanced settings.
setup.maxEmailsHelp: Number of unread emails read at each sort

run.title: Sort my emails
run.intro: An AI reads the sender, subject and date of your unread emails and sorts them by category. Everything stays on your computer, and nothing is marked as read unless you turn it on.
run.needModel: Choose an AI model above to continue.

analyze.noModel: Choose an AI model to continue.

results.noUnread: No new emails to sort right now.
results.uncertainReason: The AI’s answer could not be understood.
results.help: Your ratings teach the AI your preferences: it uses them to sort your next emails better.

errors.title: Some accounts could not be read:

markSeen.label: Mark as read after sorting
markSeen.help: Sorted emails will appear as opened in your mailbox
